content:
**Scorchbeast Mixed Meat Stew** is a consumable in *Fallout 76*.

A peppered and cooked stew made up of the meat and vital organs of a Scorchbeast. It gives a 60 minute boost to Agility, Endurance, Intelligence, and Luck while restoring a huge amount of HP and hunger and a large amount of thirst.

This is a dish Yasmin Chowdhury expresses interest in trying but hasn't had the opportunity. The player character can give it to her to try and she will give a Survival Syringe as a thank you.
